description: Pinned prompt-candidate sources for prompts.csv (protocol v2 section 6). The files are not versioned; they are downloaded to data/prompt_sources/<repository>@<commit>/<path> and checked against these hashes. A candidate's ID is <list>:<line>, its 1-based line among the file's non-empty lines.

protocol_section_6.face: VBench human and VBench-2.0 Human Fidelity
protocol_section_6.manipulation: T2V-CompBench interaction/action prompts and VBench human_action; then, in a second pass, the Kinetics-400 classes VBench's human_action prompts do not use (Chase, 2026-10-07)
protocol_section_6.body: VBench human_action and VBench-2.0 Human Anatomy
